name: MSL Collegiate Cup Bot
desc: Discord bot for the MSL Collegiate Cup, a collegiate Mobile Legends league in the Philippines. It handles match reporting, disputes, support tickets and booster tracking for players and staff.

p: The MSL Collegiate Cup is a collegiate Mobile Legends: Bang Bang league in the Philippines, and this bot ran its Discord server. It covers three jobs. Marshals open matches and players report the results. Support requests go through private ticket channels, and when a ticket closes the bot sends an HTML transcript to the player and to a log channel. A separate module tracks how many months in a row each member has boosted the server and assigns milestone roles.

img.caption: The bot being used to send out announcements.

p: This was built to completely automate the role assignments, tracking, reporting, and logging - administrative tasks that are simple yet tedious. This bot was also the front for disputes and private messages, so that none of the internal staff are singled out for decisions or sanctions imposed.

A match opens with /match_start (best of 1, 3 or 5) and players log each game with /game_result. The other team has five minutes to acknowledge it. Either side can press File Dispute instead, which pauses the timers and alerts the Marshals. Live matches are saved to disk, so a restart doesn't lose a match in progress.
This was used to categorize and manage 3,000+ student participants from more than 180 universities.
